title: The Second Primer of Blood Currents
summary: A second primer that moves blood in long currents from core to limb and builds the first strikes that rely on the full run of the arm.

title: A Middle Handbook of Pulse Binding
summary: A middle handbook of threads and holds laid through a pulse to slow limbs and dull a reaction before the blow lands.

title: The Canon of the Cleansing Blood
summary: A canon on driving taint and poison out of the blood and on keeping a patient's warmth steady while the body clears itself.

title: A Treatise on Hardened Blood
summary: A treatise on thickening the blood at the point of a blow so that the body turns aside or returns the force it receives.

title: The Course in Hemorrhagic Technique
summary: A course in blows that burst fine vessels and stay in the wound so that the target bleeds inside long after the hit.

title: A Middle Workbook of the Warm Hand
summary: A middle workbook for the warm hand that mends deeper wounds and quickens a failing pulse while the healer keeps a guard.

title: The Complete Drill of Sanguine Rhythm
summary: A full drill that sets every action to the beat of the heart so that strikes and guards and mending fall in one even cadence.
